Read the following passage and answer the question by choosing the best option. Provide only the text of the correct option as your answer.

Passage: In among all the pomp and ceremony surrounding the Apple Music launch, the firm has quietly killed off its Home Sharing feature, outraging many users. Before the iOS 8.4 update, Home Sharing let people share their iTunes music with other iOS devices on the same Wi-Fi network and was a favourite among families. But since Apple rolled out the software the feature has seemingly vanished and there has been no word as to why, leading to angry tweets and forum posts. The iOS 8.4 update was released to add the Apple Music app to phones and tablets. It also redesigned the music player and tweaked the iTunes Store.
@highlight
Reports about the demise of Home Sharing appeared on Twitter this week
@highlight
Although Apple hasn't confirmed the change, it is likely to have been removed because it rivalled Apple's Family plan on Apple Music
@highlight
For $14.99 a month, a family of six can share an Apple Music subscription
@highlight
This is similar to what Home Sharing offered for free on any Wi-Fi network
Query: Many disgruntled users have also taken to the @placeholder support forums to complain about the changes.

Options : A. Wi
B. iTunes Store
C. Twitter
D. Fi
E. Home Sharing
F. Apple Music
G. Apple

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the contetn of the correct option.
